metadata.title: Plans
metadata.description: Available plans and quotas for Princeps.

pageSubtitle: Your current plan and all available options.

sections.heading: Billing Cycle
sections.content: Monthly plans are billed on the same date each month. Annual plans are billed once per year, in advance. You will receive an invoice by email.

sections.heading: Cancellation & Refunds
sections.content: You can cancel your plan at any time. Access remains active until the end of the current billing period. No refunds are issued for already-billed periods.

sections.heading: Trial Terms
sections.content: The Free plan is permanently available with no time limit. Paid plans begin immediately after checkout. A free trial for paid plans is not currently available.
